item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Tue Aug 11, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Turn ‘I Don’t Vote’ into the Start (Not the End) of a Conversation — Wed Aug 12, 4:00 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
You’ve heard it at the door or on the phone: “Oh, I don’t vote.” Conversation over, right? Not so fast. More than one in three eligible voters skipped the 2024 elections—and here’s the surprising thing: many actually agree with Democratic priorities. If even a small fraction vote in this year’s midterms, they can move our country in a more hopeful direction. item.title: Opening Reception: Visions of the Living Earth — Sat Aug 15, 5:00 PM — Usher Gallery
item.description:
Contemporary Australian artist Tracy Marie Shapland is reflecting her ongoing exploration of the world through color, intuition, and imagination. Inspired by her experiences of travel, nature, music and human connection, Tracy Marie begins each painting with a feeling rather than a fixed plan. Now, she’s bringing that feeling to Petaluma.
Opening on Tuesday, August 11th, 2026 at Usher Gallery (located at 1 Petaluma Blvd North), her showcase, "VISIONS OF THE LIVING EARTH: where the land remembers us" fuses botanical subjects, wildlife, waterways, abstract landscapes and imagined environments while being influenced by the diverse environment of Australia and Northern California. The exhibition will run through Sunday, September 6th, 2026.
The public is invited to a celebratory Opening Reception on Saturday, August 15, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. at the gallery. The evening will feature fine wine, local refreshments, live music by the Loralee Christensen Combo and a chance to meet

item.title: Lawyers in the Library — Wed Aug 19, 5:30 PM — Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
item.description:
The Vallejo JFK Library offers the Lawyers in the Library programon the first and third Wednesdays of every month. Each meeting is 15 minutes. Space is limited and slots fill up on a first come, first serve basis. Please callor come in-person to Vallejo JFK Library at 9am on the day of the program to reserve a spot. Currently, our program offers phone consultations with a lawyer. If you have an appointment, the attorney will call you that evening between 5:30 - 7:15pm. PLEASE NOTE: In-person meetings are not currently offered. Coming to the library during the scheduled appointment window will not result in an in-person meeting. You will need a working phone to receive the call. The library is unable to provide telephone access for a lawyer consultation. If you would like more information, please call us at \(866\) 572-7587.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
AUDIO AQUARIUM
Original-Modern: Vintage feel-good rock!
Devin Ruddick: Frontman vocals, Vince “Vinsanity” Smith: Guitar, Yousef Saadeh: Guitar/vocals, Michael England: Bass, Joe de Benedetti: Drums
BASILISK
Basilisk is an up and coming Prog Fusion band based in the Bay Area. With influences from jazz to metal, they bring a little something for everyone, and are bound to get the crowd moving.
AVA STUBBLEFIELD & DIENEJI HERNANDEZ

item.title: Saturdays at The Kove — Sat Aug 22, 10:00 AM — The Kove community hub
item.description:
Everyone is welcome to join us at The Kove, a new community hub for all ages of Marin County residents. Every Saturday morning, meet at The Kove to build connections and take part in programs that nourish health, learning and belonging, including health & wellness talks, connection to resources, enrollment for our weekly food pantry, and our Neighbor Connection Hour at "Saturdays at The Kove"! The Kove is located in a welcoming space inside of Northgate Mall. Each Saturday features a different physician or expert-led health and wellness talk with plenty of time to get your questions answered. Visit www.thekove.org to stay up-to-date!
Source: Press Democrat
